newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow at the close. There were not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test at close.
Inquiry was moderate, demand was light. Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and 100 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 4,200 head confirmed mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - dressed basis - few select and choice 2-3 1275 lbs 114.00 hot weights, delivered.
Heifers - dressed basis - few select and choice 2-3 1150 lbs 114.00 hot weights, delivered.
week to date: 4200 last week: 14000 last year: 50900
